ModMetaData.name: Frame Profiler Plus
ModMetaData.author: keyz
ModMetaData.description:
Extends the RimWorld 1.7 Frame Profiler (Dev mode, Debug actions, General, Frame profiler).
Every feature is off by default. Turn them on in the mod settings, then restart.
- Harmony attribution: the time of each patch, by owner mod, plus calls that transpilers added. - Extended coverage: time constructors, lambdas, iterators and small methods. - Per-tick groups: tick time by ThingDef, job driver and comp, with a jump to the worst frame.
Load this mod directly after Harmony.
